newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek PM Simitis leaves hospital after surgery.
newsitem.headline: Greek PM Simitis leaves hospital after surgery.

text.p: Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis left an Athens state hospital on Sunday after a successful operation to remove a gallbladder stone.
"I want to thank the doctors and staff for their care," he told reporters at the hospital, adding he would return to his duties on Thursday.
Simitis, 60, who won elections in September, was admitted to hospital on Saturday accompanied by his wife Daphne.
